description: This file contains database setup and schema migration functions for a SQLAlchemy-based backend, including engine creation, schema compatibility checks, and session management.

classes.name: Engine
classes.description: SQLAlchemy Engine object used for database connections

classes.name: Session
classes.description: SQLAlchemy ORM session class for database transactions

methods.name: _build_sqlite_url
methods.description: Constructs a safe SQLite database URL from a filesystem path.

methods.name: get_database_url
methods.description: Resolves the database URL from environment variables or defaults to a local file.

methods.name: ensure_sqlite_schema_compatibility
methods.description: Performs idempotent schema migrations for SQLite, adding missing columns and creating tables if needed.

methods.name: get_db
methods.description: Provides a generator yielding a SQLAlchemy session for dependency injection.

methods.name: db_session_scope
methods.description: Context manager for database sessions with automatic commit/rollback.
